mintAuthority.summary: sUSDS is Sky's ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDS. Its own shares mint only against transferred USDS, with no current privileged share-minter or share-minter authorization path. Public SSR accrual creates parent USDS through Vat.suck and USDS_JOIN.exit; that parent issuance belongs to usds-sky and reaches sUSDS through the serial-claim dependency, not a second local mint charge. The 2026-10-01 inherited unbounded annotation is corrected to bounded local share issuance. Local two-day delayed UUPS upgrade authority and delegated SPBEAM rate-setting remain visible; bridge administration is scored separately under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: Sky Savings USDS vault
controls.capDescription: The only current share-supply increase is _mint after usds.transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),assets), reached by deposit/mint and their referral overloads. drip creates underlying USDS, not sUSDS shares; rely/file do not grant a share-minter role.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26112822, hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a, asset() returned USDS, usdsJoin() returned 0x3c0f895007ca717aa01c8693e59df1e8c3777feb and getImplementation() returned 0x4e7991e5c547ce825bdeb665ee14a3274f9f61e0. Both pinned proxy and implementation runtimes exactly matched verified deployed source. Every share totalSupply increment occurs in internal _mint, which first transfers USDS from the caller; only deposit/mint invoke it, and referral overloads forward to those same functions. No auth entrypoint mints shares or adds a share minter. A read-only mint(1e18,dead) call from Pause Proxy without deposited USDS reverted Usds/insufficient-balance. The complete sUSDS Rely/Deny census identified two live wards, Pause Proxy and SPBEAM; their rate/upgrade powers do not bypass the current share-deposit check. drip's Vat.suck/USDS_JOIN.exit creates parent USDS and never increments share totalSupply.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D08 local-wrapper review reverses the 2026-10-01 inherited D14 application: verified current SUsds share totalSupply can increase only through _mint after usds.transferFrom from the caller, reached by deposit/mint and their referral overloads. Neither auth-controlled file/rely/deny nor delegated SPBEAM rate updates mint shares or register a share-minter. The wrapper's drip creates underlying USDS through Vat.suck and USDS_JOIN.exit, without creating shares; that parent issuance belongs to usds-sky and is carried once by the serial-claim dependency. Current UUPS upgrade authority remains independently scored and is not a D14 trigger. Thus bounded describes deposit-only local share construction, not a numeric ceiling on parent USDS issuance.

review.evidence: D14/D29 local-wrapper review at Ethereum block 26112822, hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a, on 2026-10-03 reverses the 2026-10-01 inherited unbounded application under D08. The pinned SUsds proxy and current implementation match verified deployed runtimes. Current _mint transfers caller USDS before increasing share balances/totalSupply; only deposit/mint and forwarding referral overloads reach it. Pause Proxy without USDS could not mint shares in read-only simulation (Usds/insufficient-balance). Full-history Rely/Deny plus pinned wards reads identify only Pause Proxy and SPBEAM as live sUSDS wards; neither has a current privileged share-mint or share-minter registration entrypoint. SPBEAM's source/runtime match and pinned cfgs(SSR) min=200,max=3000,step=400 basis points and tau=57600 support delegated rate-setting only. drip accrual creates parent USDS with Vat.suck/USDS_JOIN.exit and does not issue sUSDS shares; the same parent liability inventory is reviewed in usds-sky, including the full 129-ward Vat census, and charged through the serial-claim dependency rather than duplicated here. The inherited USDS_JOIN mint control and parent-accrual mint scope are removed from the local wrapper record. Bounded/none-resolved-mint applies only to own deposit-backed shares. Local UUPS governance upgrade and rate powers remain visible with partial execution scopes; no unbounded-governed classification or complete parent certificate is claimed. SKY Chief approval weight is lock-escrowed, not live-balance, with no fixed vote duration and the current 48-hour Pause on the governor route.
